top_choice_rationale: Base editing for Liu, Komor and Gaudelli is a defined chemical conversion, deamination of one base without double-strand cleavage, whose mechanism has been experimentally dissected (nickase strand choice, UGI, evolved TadA). The cytosine and adenine editors are two separable, attributable inventions, widely reproduced, and the method enables a whole community. It is distinct from the 2020 Cas9 cleavage prize; the Target-AID priority issue must be handled in the citation wording.
